title: Register update preserves an upper bound
statement: Let $v$ assign a natural-number value to each of $m$ registers, let $r$ be a register, and let $B,n$ be natural numbers. If every value assigned by $v$ is at most $B$ and $n\leq B$, then replacing the value at $r$ by $n$ leaves every register value at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every register value under $v$ is at most $B$
